name: What causes basement water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement water damage can result from several issues. Common causes include foundation cracks, which allow groundwater to seep in; plumbing leaks from burst pipes or faulty appliances like water heaters; poor exterior drainage that directs rainwater towards the foundation; and overloaded gutters or downspouts. Additionally, significant storms and rising water tables can contribute to basement flooding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement water damage is often caused by foundation cracks, plumbing leaks, poor exterior drainage, and severe weather.
